name: Block Gallery to Carousel Lightbox
author: Atakan Au

sections.description:
Block Gallery to Carousel Lightbox is a user-friendly plugin for the WordPress Block Editor that seamlessly converts your default Block Gallery into a beautiful Image Carousel Lightbox featuring attractive thumbnail displays. Perfect for beginners, this plugin requires no coding skills and easily integrates with your existing WordPress setup. For more information, visit blog page!

Support

Support requests, bug reports, feedback, and feature requests can be submitted via the support forum or the plugin’s blog page.

If you find the plugin useful, please consider leaving a 5-star review on WordPress.org. You can also support my work with a donation.

Collaboration

I am a freelance developer available for custom development, integrations, and technical consulting. If you have a project related to this plugin, feel free to get in touch.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the block-gallery-to-carousel-lightbox folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How to Configure Block Gallery for Carousel Lightbox?

  1. Add a Gallery block to your post or page.
  2. Set Gallery images to Thumbnail resolution.
  3. Add CSS class “atakanau_bgtcl_auto_container” in the Advanced section.
  4. Link images to Media File.
